SessionStart.command: if [ -n "${ARGOS_TMUX_HOOK_DIRECTORY:-}" ]; then "$ARGOS_TMUX_PYTHON" -m argos.tools.tmux_agent_hook "$ARGOS_TMUX_HOOK_DIRECTORY" "$ARGOS_TMUX_GENERATION" antigravity SessionStart; fi

Stop.command: if [ -n "${ARGOS_TMUX_HOOK_DIRECTORY:-}" ]; then "$ARGOS_TMUX_PYTHON" -m argos.tools.tmux_agent_hook "$ARGOS_TMUX_HOOK_DIRECTORY" "$ARGOS_TMUX_GENERATION" antigravity Stop; fi

hooks.command: if [ -n "${ARGOS_TMUX_HOOK_DIRECTORY:-}" ]; then "$ARGOS_TMUX_PYTHON" -m argos.tools.tmux_agent_hook "$ARGOS_TMUX_HOOK_DIRECTORY" "$ARGOS_TMUX_GENERATION" antigravity SubagentLink; fi
